name: LI-AR0234CSC-GMSL2-120H

sources.title: LI-AR0234CSC-GMSL2-xxxH datasheet, revision 1.0, 22 June 2021 (Leopard Imaging)
sources.covers: sensor (onsemi AR0234CS), optical format, resolution, pixel size, frame rate, shutter, serializer, power supply, IP67, weight, both lens options (EFL, f-number, horizontal FOV, optical distortion), USB 3.0 kit

note: A colour global-shutter GMSL2 camera (serializer Maxim MAX9295A, FAKRA Z, IP67, 9-19 VDC). Maximum frame rate "120 fps @ full resolution", RAW output (bit depth not stated: format "RAW", bits null); through Leopard's USB 3.0 kit (LI-USB30-DESER-GMSL2) 1920 x 1200 at 30 fps. Only a horizontal FOV is stated; the library takes square pixels for the vertical angle. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the datasheet states an optical distortion figure but no coefficients; calibrate a unit. Power consumption "TBD" (null). mass_g is the stated "~ 44 g" (approximate). size_mm is null: the dimensions are only in a drawing. Lens 120H: EFL 2.8 mm, F/2.0, 122 degrees horizontal (the part number says 120H), optical distortion "< -66.5%", M12; with that much distortion a pinhole fitted to 122 degrees misplaces most of the image, so calibrate before trusting pixel positions.
